AdminEvidence.description: Admins only (design §4): where the observation came from.
AdminEvidence.title: AdminEvidence

AvailabilityState.description: Observed availability of an offer. A failed crawl is never OUT_OF_STOCK (DAT-06).
AvailabilityState.title: AvailabilityState

Capabilities.description: What this snapshot can answer. All explicit: a consumer never guesses from absence.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

CaveatCode.description: Machine-readable caveats; the API renders their text per locale.
CaveatCode.title: CaveatCode

MoneyValue.description: An exact amount at its currency's ISO 4217 exponent, as text plus integer minor units.
MoneyValue.title: MoneyValue

Rating.description:
The retailer's published rating on its own ``scale`` (e.g. ``"5"`` for 0-5 stars).

The producer never rescales; consumers compare ratings only on the same scale or after
normalising ``average / scale`` themselves.
Rating.title: Rating

RetailerStatus.description: Coverage of a retailer in this snapshot. Only ``supported`` backs an absence claim.
RetailerStatus.title: RetailerStatus

ReviewState.description: Lifecycle of a match edge (MAT-05, MAT-07).
ReviewState.title: ReviewState

Size.description: The pack size as published, e.g. ``{"value": "50", "unit": "ml"}``. Never converted.
Size.title: Size

firebase.description: Every route, including unknown paths, needs a Firebase ID token carrying a `role` claim (viewer or admin). Cookies are ignored. Every response is `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.
